# CiteFlow — AI Visibility Platform

CiteFlow is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform that helps websites get cited by AI search engines including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.

## Core Features
- **AI Visibility Score** — Get a 0-100 GEO score with breakdown of AI Visibility, FAQ Coverage, Entity Clarity, and Authority
- **GEO Report** — Identify missing components and get AI-generated suggestions to improve citation frequency
- **AI Monitoring** — Track your brand's presence across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude outputs
- **Content Optimization** — Actionable recommendations for FAQ schema, entity clarity, and authority signals
